issues.problem: The released-kernel bug is described as a dL/dM error. It also corrupts dL/dalpha, so the opacity, mean and covariance gradients of sampled (M=1) Gaussians are wrong whenever a neighbour in depth order has a different mask. The plan (paper.md §7) says this, but the report and README do not.
issues.evidence: Reviewer check (3 stacked G≈1 Gaussians, every mask pattern): official build dL/dM rel err 0.09-0.52 and dL/dopacity rel err 0.16-1.05 for mixed patterns (e.g. M=(0,1,0): dO err 1.05). Both errors are 0 for all-0/all-1 patterns. The exact build matches autograd to <1e-3 in all 8 patterns.
issues.fix: Reword: 'the accum_rec recursion uses the wrong mask, which biases dL/dM and dL/dalpha (hence opacity/geometry grads) when adjacent masks differ'.

issues.problem: The 461k of the compressed run comes mostly from stopping densification at step 1500, not from masking. The count is set beside 785k (densifying to step 2000), which invites a misreading.
issues.evidence: training.jsonl: compressed 471,966 vs smoke-1 470,858 at step 1400 (no masking reduction through the λ window). mask_prune removed ~460 and the final sample ~10.7k (471,507→460,808).
issues.fix: Report the masking-attributable removal (~11k, 2.3 %) explicitly, or compare with an uncompressed-density control.

issues.problem: The plugin uses a re-implemented Inria ADC, while the baseline is gsplat DefaultStrategy (+reset). The Δ-PSNR and the count ratio vs baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-1600 therefore also include ADC-implementation differences, not just MaskGaussian.
issues.evidence: Smoke at 2k: 785k (plugin ADC) vs 779k (gsplat) is similar, but at 30k the paper's 3DGS garden count is 5.81M vs our gsplat 4.55M.
issues.fix: Optionally run a mask-off control (lambda 0, mask_prune_in_densify false, no mask_prune/final_sample) on one scene, or state the confound in the report.

issues.problem: Black background (official) vs the white-background gsplat baseline: a small confound in the baseline delta, not listed among the fidelity gaps.
issues.evidence: renderer.py DEFAULTS background [0,0,0]; CLAUDE.md runtime baseline white
issues.fix: List it in report.md fidelity gaps.

issues.problem: total_steps is not tied to the runtime --steps. Any other --steps silently skips the final single-sample keep (this is documented).
issues.fix: Raise in after_backward if step > total_steps, or warn at initialize; bench_request already pins 30000.

probe_assessment.why: Compares kernel image and dL/dM/dL/dopacity to a float64 autograd compositor and to a backward.cu replica. Ignoring the mask, or a wrong accumulation, fails it. It also asserts that the official build deviates under mixed masks, which pins down which kernel is built.
Zero mask gradients on visible unsampled Gaussians fail it. The naive mask×opacity control does fail (0/32).
A deterministic/thresholded mask fails the 4σ rate test, a missing ST gradient fails the Jacobian test, and a wrong init fails the σ(9) check.
Checks the value and gradient inside and at the inclusive window edges, and zero outside.
A fixture with p≈0 Gaussians must be pruned at 600 and 16000 and not off-cadence. It has a control with the mask test disabled, the final single sample, and mask-score copying on clone/split.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Per-scene supp. tables = MaskGaussian-α (main Table 1 caption: λ_m=0.1 on 19k–20k; the per-scene averages 27.43/1.205M equal the α row). run_all.py's active setting is β, but the α block is commented in and matches the tables.

Resolution: run_all.py passes no -r, so the -r -1 default rescales images/ to width 1600. mipnerf360-1600 and baseline3dgs-mipnerf360-1600-30000 are correct (garden 26.93/4.55M, counter 29.04/1.19M verified).
Mask enters only α-blending (not opacity), with the mask mean over all N Gaussians; τ=1; mask lr 0.01, Adam eps 1e-15; init [10,1].

Official schedule verified in train.py: densify_and_prune at it>500, it%100==0, it<15000 (opacity|never-sampled|big-ws after 3000; screen-size test is dead because max_radii2D is zeroed in densification_postfix, as the plugin notes). mask_prune in the elif branch at it>=15000, it%1000==0. scene.save (save_ply_default = one Gumbel sample) at 30000 precedes that step's mask_prune.
Runtime order (optimizer step before density), with-replacement view sampling, final-iteration optimizer step, RNG, SSIM/LPIPS, SH-degree bump at step 1001 vs 1000: all negligible.
Default = released kernel is the right choice: it produced the paper numbers, and the exact variant is a separate diagnostic.
summary: Faithful port. Setting (α), resolution (1600) and baseline are correct. The vendored kernel is byte-identical to 540dc11 apart from an #ifdef. Mask sampling, loss and pruning schedule match the official train.py/gaussian_model.py. The claimed backward bug is independently confirmed: accum_rec uses the current Gaussian's mask, and it affects dL/dalpha as well as dL/dM. Keeping the released kernel as default is correct. 10/10 tests pass. Only minor documentation/confound issues.
